title: Mama Lou's, Happyland and Mary's Camp on the lake
summary: Clayton recalls leading a band with Andrew Jefferson at Mama Lou's, which closed after she died, plus Happyland and Mary's Camp, and the location of Lincoln Beach.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah, like that or something. Something up higher. Right. And I used to play out at Mama Lou. You ever been out there?
Oh, yeah. I used to go there a lot.
Well, me and Andrew Jefferson, we had the band there.
They didn't go there a lot because they cut it out there a few years ago. Yeah, after she died, yeah.
She died or so. She was a good woman. She had a gold spot right there. Yeah. They had some other people, in-laws try to take it but they couldn't come up to the seafood, you know, like she did.
In 56 or 57, the other people took it over and it didn't last through the summer.
That's right. And the happy land I used to play out there with Israel going. Oh, yeah.
That's not going anymore either, is it?
No, I think that people died out there.
That was going about two years ago and then they quit last year. They quit, yeah.
Well, I left Israel out there.
Well, I heard you way out there farther down the lake, that was 1951 I remember.
That was down at Mary's Camp, yeah. That's the last camp down out in the water.
Yeah, I haven't been down there since, and since then they built Lincoln Beach I guess. Or was Lincoln Beach already there? Do you remember?
Let me see, yeah Lincoln Beach was there.
Well where is Lincoln Beach then?

I don't even know in relation to Mary. It's like you're going, you go past Mama Lewis and keep straight on the next stop is to Lincoln Beach. And then when you go straight on now, Mary's Camp, when you make that right turn to come. And Mary's Camp is farther down in Lincoln Beach.
Yeah, that's right. I thought maybe that's the same as Lincoln Beach now where you played before.
No, no, that's Mary's Camp.
That was farther then.
